title: Confirm whether Positioned(left:/right:) illustration badges in intro pages need PositionedDirectional for RTL
why: AX-1's RTL rule is written against EdgeInsets.only(left/right) and Alignment.centerLeft/Right, but Positioned(left:/right:) has the identical non-mirroring failure mode under RTL that PositionedDirectional(start:/end:) avoids. app_intro_screen_l1_test.dart's RTL smoke test only checks the screen mounts without throwing, not badge placement, so a mirroring regression on these floating badges in Hebrew locale would not be caught. This may be an intentional 'decorative collage doesn't need to mirror' choice rather than a bug — needs a visual check to confirm either way.
recommendation: Take a Locale('he') screenshot of AppIntroScreen pages 2-3 (reusing the app_intro_rewards_cta_overlap_test.dart rig) and confirm badge placement reads correctly; switch to PositionedDirectional(start:/end:) if not.
acceptance_criteria: A golden or screenshot test of pages 2-3 in Locale('he') exists and has been reviewed for correct badge placement
